dialogues.speaker: Ginkgo
dialogues.text: Our kind Fairy dances just as beautifully as the Goddess of Creation!

dialogues.speaker: Chestnut
dialogues.text: Here we go again... Let me guess, she was dancing when your grandfather saw her create life, was she?

dialogues.speaker: Ginkgo
dialogues.text: Haha, very funny. A goddess is all-powerful! Of course she can dance.
